description: List SupStack health goals — their ids, names, and categories. Use the returned `id` values as the `goals` argument to `supstack_rate_stack` and `supstack_recommend` (those tools need goal ids, not free text). Call this first to map a user's plain-language goal ("sleep better", "build muscle") to the correct id. Optionally filter with a free-text `query` (matches id or name) or a `category` id.
name: supstack_goals
